latest.title: 🚀 Elevating Posture: Building an AI-Powered AWS Security Maturity Agent (Serverless & Zero-Trust)
latest.description:
Modern cloud engineering faces a costly paradox: slow, manual security audits versus expensive, legacy tools. The issue isn't missing data, but the operational fragmentation needed to prioritize it. True resilience requires moving past static snapshots.

To solve this, ASMMv2 introduces an autonomous, 100% serverless AI agent. It automatically evaluates cloud environments against the official AWS Security Maturity Model v2 framework, turning fragmented telemetry into a prioritized roadmap.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
